Blood Family Rejected Me, My Grizzly Dad Made Me King
Blood Family Rejected Me, My Grizzly Dad Made Me KingAt eighteen, I was discovered by my billionaire birth family, only to be treated like a burden. They made me wear cast-offs, let the fake heir humiliate me, and even my fiancée saw me as an embarrassment. They expected me to lower my head and plead for acceptance. Instead, I called the one person who truly raised me—my adoptive father, a grizzly bear of a man from the Northlands. They had no idea he controlled half the ports. With that one call, the entire city fell quiet. I didn’t stay for their money or their name. I left them with nothing but regret, because my dad always taught me: if they try to make you kneel, stand even taller.Watch Now

New Release 🆕

Modern

For three years, Elena kept being the reasonable girlfriend, endlessly giving in to Adrian and to Sophie, the girl he always pitied. At a four-person meal for five, she was the only one paying—and the punchline every time. But when her design success was stolen and she was left alone in the pouring rain, Elena finally saw the truth. She severed every connection and left for Boston, starting over while Adrian was left with nothing but regret.

Five Seats, One Betrayal 2

Modern

When Kevin Mercer’s theft scandal comes to light, Tessa Bradford walks away and refuses to stay tied to his ruin. With her family and friends beside her, she steadily rebuilds her life while pushing his wrongdoing into the open. Kevin’s arrogance and careless decisions also drag Nina Withers into debt and hardship, and once his actions are exposed, his reputation collapses. A failed suicide attempt leaves him paralyzed, while Tessa finds lasting peace through legal action and finally breaks free from his shadow.

[Dubbed]My Fortune, His Downfall

Revenge

Her S-rank beast chose another woman and left Hannah to die. Heartbroken, she breaks their bond and turns to a scarred white lion no one wants. Her smug ex thinks she'll come back begging—but this broken lion may prove everyone wrong.

[Dubbed]The White Lion Nobody Wanted

Modern

After Victor Hale betrays Wendy Stone, an unexpected ally appears in her mother-in-law, Susan. Susan cuts Victor off and appoints Ethan Hale as her successor. Wendy divorces Victor and begins a fresh chapter with Ethan, while Victor and his mistress Mia face the consequences of their choices.

[Dubbed]His Family Chose Me

Modern

Raised in the countryside for twenty years, Julia Brown is finally brought back to the Smith family as their rightful daughter. But Tracy Smith won’t give up the fake identity she has been enjoying, and she keeps setting trap after trap. While Julia fights to claim the life that should be hers, she unexpectedly runs into Issac Pace, the heir bound to her by an old promise. As their bond grows, Julia must face a new question: will love help her win, or make everything harder?

[Dubbed] Reclaiming My Heiress Life

Modern

At the crossroads of love and ambition, Chloe, Sam, Sean, and Nina are forced to confront a life-changing question: study abroad or stay behind? Chloe breaks from Sam to pursue Oxford and the future she has dreamed of, leaving their relationship in pieces. As Sam remains home to stand by Nina, Chloe begins again with Sean’s support, discovering a strength she never expected. But with secrets rising to the surface and every path pulling them in different directions, each of them must live with what their choices have cost. Will they hold on to what was, or finally release the past and start over?

[Dubbed] Choosing Myself

Ancient

After a family tragedy, Joyce grows up under Henry’s care. Misunderstandings, separation, and national turmoil push her to become stronger, and after they finally clear the air and stand together through every ordeal, their feelings are confirmed. Just when it seems they can breathe again, plague hits Coldmere, and a harsher test begins.

[Dubbed]My Little Wife

Modern

Hailey Quinn has endured her husband’s abuse, his control over every dollar, and a terrifying scheme that points to murder. All she wants now is a safe life for herself and her daughter. Yet leaving a monster behind only opens a new battle—against bias at work, crushing poverty, and legal traps. Is freedom really possible, or will her past pull her back into the dark?

[Dubbed]A Price for Freedom

Modern

On Halloween, Clara watches her son bring home his father's mistress and ask her to become his new mother. Shattered, Clara leaves with her mother's ashes, walking away from the family she gave everything to build. They are sure she'll come back pleading. Instead, she chooses herself, revives her dance career, and begins again. As the family they took for granted crumbles, her husband and son realize too late what they've lost.

This Halloween, My Son Asked for a New Mom

Ancient

Given a second chance at life, Lydia brought Andy and Luna’s affair into the light, then chose Ryan as her husband. At the same time, Andy was pushed into marrying Ruby, only for Ruby to be dragged into a fierce battle with Luna. Their conflict shattered the Scott family. Lydia, however, had already walked away from it all—free at last, and at peace.

[Dubbed] Reborn: My General Husband

Modern

Seraphina is given a second chance after being reborn, and she binds her soul to a dying wyrm—only to discover he is truly a legendary dragon. With dark cultists closing in on the Beastmaster Order, they must form a dangerous Soul Pact to stand against the threat and protect the realm before history repeats itself.

[Dubbed] My Rejected Pet is the Ancient Dragon God

Modern

When a trivial argument over the holiday plans pushes Anna too far, she finally snaps. With a toxic husband and a greedy mother-in-law making life unbearable, she chooses herself and files for divorce. Supported by her loving family, Anna returns their petty refund with perfect attitude, then goes out and buys the dream ride she’s always wanted. Now she’s hitting the road and taking her life back home on her own terms.

[Dubbed] Drive Away, Start Again

Ancient

Feigning a saintly image, she married a lazy husband to secure an easy life. But when his affair leaves his mistress pregnant and a war erupts over the throne, the bride everyone dismissed turns her family's grain fortune into a weapon, brings down a crown prince, and claims the title of Princess Regent.

[Dubbed] Bow to No Crown

Modern

Hannah Blake was punished for something she didn’t do—after offering neighbors free rides and fixing the road on her own, she was falsely fined. Meanwhile, Lila Stevens tried to profit through insurance and crowdfunding scams, but Hannah collected proof and exposed her. In the end, the neighbors apologized and gave the money back, and as justice settled in, the community slowly found peace again.

[Dubbed] Free Rides, Hard Lessons

Modern

After Stella is abandoned in the wilderness by the fiancé she trusted, she sets out to honor her late parents alone and begins to see the truth behind their relationship. Just when he comes back pleading for another chance, her heart starts to soften—until a hidden recording changes everything. The sweet promises fade, and she learns he never wanted her love, only her inheritance.

[Dubbed] How to Bury a Fiancé

Modern

A frail girl from the Republic of China is forced into the mountains to marry the feared “mountain god” in order to save her elder sister, only to stumble upon a chilling scam hidden behind the legend.

[Dubbed] Girl of Mountain

Modern

Janet Preston’s marriage to Phillip Bennett falls into crisis as they fight over custody of Jude Preston, while Genesis Preston and Nicholas Carter are locked in a business rivalry. Amid family betrayal and a growing hunger for revenge, every relationship is pushed to the edge.

[Dubbed]She Came Back for What Was Hers

Modern

At this campus, football star Hunter, student body president Felix, bully Jessica, and the wealthy Axel hold all the power, and their toxic circle has pushed too many students to the edge. When Olivia’s two roommates become their next targets, she decides enough is enough. Keeping a low profile as just another student, Olivia draws close to Hunter and Felix, then uses what she learns to uncover their secrets and set them against one another. One by one, Hunter’s starting role slips away, Felix’s political future is shattered, and Jessica’s behavior is brought into the light. The clique that once ruled everything starts to break apart. But Axel has understood Olivia’s true plan from the start. As Hunter and Felix fight over her ahead of the spring formal, Axel makes Olivia an offer too tempting to ignore—money and power in exchange for her next move. Her revenge may only be the opening act of a far larger game.

I Played Innocent and Stole Her Three Sweethearts 2

Modern

Twenty days before the wedding, Emma joins a camping trip with her fiancé Ethan and his friends, only to find Ethan repeatedly siding with his childhood friend Chloe. When Emma learns Chloe has hidden her bracelet and quietly reshaped the entire wedding to suit herself, something in her finally breaks. She calls off the campsite, moves out of the apartment, quits her job, and cuts everyone off. By the time Ethan understands what he has lost, Emma has already gone for good.

Twenty Days Before the Wedding, I Returned My Fiancé.

Most Popular 🔥

Modern

When Alexander Hartley is betrayed and left broke, he makes a shocking decision: he marries Eleanor, the homeless woman everyone dismisses as a fool. But Eleanor is no fool at all—she is the hidden billionaire heiress of the Vance family. Years ago, Alexander saved her, and she has stayed by his side in secret, quietly ruining the lives of those who threatened him as their marriage turns into true love.

My Homeless Bride Is a Billionaire Heiress

Modern

With Winnie and their child taken hostage, Enzo is shoved into an impossible choice: save one or lose both. But he refuses to accept that fate. At the cliff’s ragged edge, he grips Winnie’s hand with everything he has, fighting to keep her from falling. Yet Winnie, heart in pieces, begs him to let go. She says she will never trust him again, never take his hand again. Before the end, she leaves him with one desperate plea: “Raise our child.” Can Enzo mend what’s broken, or is Winnie about to slip away forever?

Silent Sacrifice: The Godfather's Hidden Child

Modern

Elena was supposed to live like a Mafia Don’s wife, but instead she survives on $800 a month—pregnant, underfed, and running out of options. Hoping to pay for an abortion, she takes a job at a club. On her very first night, she hears her husband claim he sends his wife $300,000 every month. One of them is lying, and the truth will shatter everything.

The Don's Million-Dollar Wife Was Starving

Modern

Winnie gave up her organ and carried the Godfather’s child in order to save him. But after being misled by lies, he comes to believe she betrayed him and turns his love into deep hatred. Now she returns with their hidden child, and the painful story between them begins again. Can the truth finally set them right?

Silent Sacrifice: The Godfather's Hidden Child

Modern

Nora Taylor, a bookish transfer student, thinks she can dodge trouble at her new rough high school by targeting the easiest kid in class—sleepy, quiet Mason Cole. She takes his food, drinks his water, and pushes him around, never guessing he’s actually the school’s most feared top dog. Yet Mason never pushes back. Instead, he seems almost happy to let Nora bully him, because he’s already fallen for her.

The Pushover I Bullied Was the School's Top Dog

Modern

Four-year-old twins spend every coin in their piggy bank on a daddy, and fate brings back their mother Elodie’s ruthless ex, Cassian Moretti. He has spent five years believing she betrayed him, yet the two little ones calling him Dad make it hard to leave. Behind the reunion lie forged records, stolen money, and a jealous rival, all pointing to a buried truth: the children he’s guarding may be his own, and someone is determined to keep Elodie from ever waking up.

My Twins Bought My Mafia Ex!

Modern

Alessia grew up as the treasured princess of the powerful Moretti Mafia family, only to learn at twenty that she had been switched at birth. When she returns to her biological billionaire family, she steps into a home ruled by favoritism, control, and a fake heiress who knows how to play the victim. Alessia won’t chase affection or accept disrespect. With confidence, wealth, sharp instincts, and the steadfast backing of the Morettis, she answers every slight with poise and turns every insult into a lesson, pushing the Hale family to face their failures, draw real boundaries, and understand what family truly means.

She Came Home to Rule

Modern

Killed by Dante Marchetti’s hatred and the child she carried, Nola is sent back to the day the mafia family first picked her from a group home. This time, Dante remembers too and finds his true sister, Sera, but Nola still gets drawn back into the Marchetti world. She only wants a quiet life, yet violence keeps finding her: she is shot while shielding Sera and later faces kidney failure. When Nola decides to leave and die alone, Dante secretly gives her his kidney, loving her in silence as he realizes she may never know the truth.

Reborn to Escape My Mafia Stepbrother

Modern

She hid behind a fake photo and vanished on her online boyfriend, never expecting to meet him. But when she moves into her best friend’s house, the man she ghosted turns out to be her friend’s cold billionaire older brother. With her secret one step from exposure, the arrival of his perfect arranged-marriage match throws everything into chaos.

My Catfish Victim Is Actually My Bestie’s Brother

Modern

Mia Romano hides an extraordinary secret: she can hear and understand animals. When her mother’s medical bills push her into desperation, she accepts a job at the intimidating Moretti estate and saves Bianco, a white lion condemned to die. That act pulls her into a web of lies, linking Alessandro Moretti’s fiancée to a brutal ambush from the past. As Mia and the feared crime lord chase the truth, doubt gives way to trust—and trust to love. But with betrayal closing in on both their families, Mia must choose between disappearing or standing beside the man, the lion, and the future she never imagined.

The Mafia King’s Lion Chose Me

Modern

After Ethan leaves Chloe at the altar for the thirteenth time, she makes a bold call to his influential adoptive father, Vincent Valenti, and asks him to stand in as her groom. What starts as a practical fix quickly shifts into a far more dangerous arrangement. Then Ethan shows up with his mistress Vivian, and Vincent delivers a stunning announcement that changes everything.

After 13 No‑Shows, I Married the Godfather

Modern

He abandoned me to die. Then fate gave us both a second chance at life—only for him to pick my sister, while I was sent to marry a supposedly dying old mafia don. I accepted it. But my husband is not old at all: he's young, devastatingly handsome, and feared by the entire underworld. He treats me like royalty, while my ex's dream wedding begins to crumble. Now the man who discarded me wants me back. It's too late. The woman he threw away is now the mafia king's cherished wife.

Married Off to Save Face, I Got the Mafia King Instead

Modern

After three years in a suffocating marriage, Emma Hayes, an Ivy League graduate, sinks into depression and is left broke after her divorce. Desperate for a way forward, she signs a contract to become the stepmother of Noah, the 4-year-old son of Damian Moretti, the head of New York’s top mafia family. Her kindness slowly eases the boy’s fears, and Emma begins to rebuild her life with dignity and peace. But when her ex-husband Julian comes back to pull her into the same misery, Damian stands guard over her every time. What begins as a contract marriage soon turns into something neither of them expected.

Dumped My Ex, Married the Mafia Don

Modern

Vienna, the housemaid’s daughter, is trapped under heiress Isabella’s schemes. In silence, she falls for Isabella’s influential uncle, Salvatore. Their hidden romance leads to pregnancy, and when the truth surfaces, Salvatore stands by Vienna, reveals Isabella’s deceit, and marries her.

She Stole My Men. I Chose Her Uncle

Modern

Olive, a rare Silver Fox shifter, thought Silas—the powerful Green Serpent heir—had given her a place to belong when he claimed her at auction. But after she bears his three serpent pups, his former love comes back, and Silas turns cold, cruelly passing Olive’s mate bond to his younger brother. Rhett, the feared Black Serpent warlord, takes Olive and her children in without a second thought and gives them the protection and devotion Silas never offered.

Traded to His Warlord Brother, My Serpent Ex-Mate Goes Mad with Regret

Modern

Cast out by the wealthy family that should have claimed her, Jessica turns to a marriage of convenience with a chilly billionaire for the promised $10 million trust. Instead of the easy win she expected, she finds two children who cling to her and a husband who never lets anyone push her aside. As envious elites and calculating relatives stir up trouble around their fragile new home, Jessica refuses to back down. Yet the man behind that frosty exterior is hiding a childhood secret that could change everything about their marriage.

Billionaire’s Rebel Bride

Modern

Rory will do whatever it takes to earn a place at a top hockey camp—even if it means entering a space built for men. Forced to room with Jaxson, the camp’s commanding captain, Rory faces nonstop pressure on and off the ice. But as rivalry gives way to uneasy closeness, Jaxson’s growing protectiveness starts to feel like something far harder to deny.

Faking as My Brother: My Hockey Roommate's Dirty Desire

Fantasy

Elara gave her heart to a proud phoenix for years, only to be treated like a burden. Then she turned to Kael, a rejected dragon, and nothing stayed the same. Gentle with her and merciless to anyone who crosses her, Kael is far more dangerous than the academy realizes. But with Lucien now demanding her back, the growing bond between Elara and Kael could stir up a force no one can contain.

My Cruel Shifter Regretted Losing Me Too Late

Modern

Vivian spent five years hiding that she was a powerful venture capitalist, all to spare Sebastian’s pride. But the night he hands her custom wedding gown to another woman, shames her in front of everyone, and leaves her standing in the rain, she finally lets go. One call to mafia Don Adrian Carbone is all it takes to bring Sebastian’s empire crashing down—and too late, he learns who he lost.

The Billionaire Bride He Threw Away

Modern

After marrying mafia heir Adrian, I survived on mystery-box draws for three years, scraping by on as little as $9.90 a month. When our daughter needed an $8000 surgery and I had nothing left, I could only watch her slip away. Once I uncovered the lies spun by my family, my stepsister, and a so-called friend, Adrian came to Honolulu with money in hand, hoping to make amends. But no fortune can bring back a life lost. Carrying the weight of that trauma, I choose not to reconcile and instead hold on to the peace I finally built abroad.

Mafia Husband Gave Me Only $9.90 Monthly Cost

Modern

Mia should be celebrating her wedding day, but a wounded black panther and a runaway girl pull her into a dangerous conflict tied to a rival godfather’s hidden secret. With Alessandro beside her, she races to defend her rescue center, expose the truth, and save a family before time runs out.

The Mafia King’s Lion Chose Me 2

Modern

Forgotten by the parents who built two picture-perfect homes for her sister, Nora is left with nowhere that feels like hers. As her college belongings are lost and her scholarship hangs by a thread, she is pushed to the edge. Far from everything she knew, she sets out to claim a real home for herself—one no one can take away. A quiet, powerful tale of neglect, loss, and finding where you belong.

Two Homes, No Room for Me

Modern

Mira Hale, a merfolk researcher, mistakes the formidable Siren Auren for a lonely deep-sea merman and, for her thesis, teaches him a courtship song and dance. She never suspects that in Auren’s eyes, she has already chosen him as her mate. But when she discovers what he truly is and tries to run, he brings her to a remote island. As Mira’s body starts to change and forgotten childhood memories surface, she realizes Auren once saved her life. Caught between the human world and the Siren she may have loved all along, she must decide where she truly belongs.

I Forgot the Siren-He Never Forgot Me

Modern

Ivy Bennett is dismissed by everyone as an autistic fool, so her family sends her to marry Alessandro Valenti in her sister’s place, expecting the feared Mafia Don in a wheelchair to be the death of her. They don’t know Ivy hides an extraordinary gift: she can understand animals. A peacock reveals poison, a wounded K9 points to a concealed injury, a starving horse opens the door to a billion-dollar deal, and even a stray cat leads to a buried inheritance. Time after time, Ivy saves Alessandro—until the woman everyone underestimated becomes the one he would kill to protect.

They Called Me a Fool, Until I Saved the Mafia Don

Modern

Emma is trapped in a cruel "Freeze" game of humiliation and betrayal, played by her fiancé Ryan and her best friend Stella. She breaks off the wedding, heads to New York, and uses solid proof to uncover their lies—then rebuilds her career and life while making sure they face the consequences.

He Married My Best Friend for a Game

Modern

Mia can slip into the dreams of the person who truly loves her. After her childhood crush rejects her without mercy, she turns to Jaxon, the school’s feared bad boy, only to discover he’s the one begging her to pull him out of his nightmares. As Mia learns the truth about his painful past, the two grow closer. Just when her first love comes back desperate to win her over, Mia realizes her heart is already with someone else.

When I Stopped Entering His Dreams

Modern

For a decade, Adele Moretti holds on to her place as Vito’s fiancée, swallowing the jokes about her weight and trusting that marriage will come in time. But when she learns Vito has been bending the tradition all along to keep another woman near him, everything she believed falls apart. At last, when the red slip is drawn, Adele chooses herself and steps onto Luca’s boat. Chosen without secrecy and loved without hesitation, she begins again—while Vito understands too late what he has lost.

He Called Me Fat. The Don Called Me Wife

Modern

He hid behind someone else’s identity to romance a formidable female CEO online. But after he disappears, fate brings them face-to-face at work, where she catches the one thing he couldn’t disguise—his unmistakable voice. Now he must face the truth behind his deception for a chance at real love.

My Online Ex Is the Mafia Queen

Modern

Elena Hart has already seen through her fiancé’s scheme: he assumes her face blindness will make her easy to fool, then pushes her toward a fake groom while handing Vivian the wedding that was meant for her. But Elena refuses to play along. She picks Ryan Gallo instead and makes the marriage official before anyone can stop her. Now her ex is raging to get her back, while Ryan gives her the one thing she’s never been offered before—being chosen first. When betrayal leads to the altar, can real love still follow?

He Made Me Pick a Fake Groom. I Made It Legal

Modern

After Dean blamed her for his childhood friend’s death and she died because of it, Sloane wakes up on the hurricane day that changed everything. This time, she obeys the evacuation order, captures the real story on record, and chooses herself first. But when Brynn spins the truth online and Dean sides with her again, official footage lays bare the truth. Sloane calls off the engagement and refuses to give betrayal a second chance.

The Day of the Hurricane, I Didn’t Save Him

Modern

When rival clans threaten the Grey family, CEO Ella stages a mate challenge to protect her power. Ryan, secretly the Moonshadow Sovereign but living as a beggar, enters her life through a contract marriage. At the Silver Moon Summit, his true identity comes to light, the villains are defeated, and Ella gains the family life she longed for.

My Beggar Husband Is the Alpha

Modern

Vincent Marino has kept his true identity hidden for years, living quietly as a fisherman to raise his adopted daughter, Lauren, far from the power of Empire City. But after studying abroad, Lauren is drawn in by her wealthy biological father and turns her back on Vincent in public. Then at the Father’s Day banquet, his three daughters expose the truth: the man she abandoned is actually the city’s real king.

The Adoptive Father She Betrayed Was the Mafia Don

Modern

Nerissa Bellandi was born blind, yet she alone can see the colors of human souls. In her first life, she chose Lazzaro Don and paid for it with poison and a death in the sea. Reborn on the night of the matchmaking dinner, she turns away from the man who betrayed her and stands beside Severin Valtieri, the so-called crippled heir with ambition of his own. Her gift and his hidden strength become a deadly match as they uncover traitors, defeat their enemies, and rise together to the throne of the underworld. This time, Nerissa will never be used and discarded again.

Soul Sight

Modern

For three years, despite being married to wealthy heir Adrian, I lived on scraps of irregular support. When I urgently needed help, my own family, stepsister, and a fake friend turned on me, framing me with cruel rumors. Adrian later arrived in Honolulu with money and regret once the truth came out—but some wounds don’t heal. I refused him and chose a peaceful life on my own.

Mafia Husband Gave Me Only $9.90 Monthly Cost--SEASON 2

Modern

Adrian is convinced love has to be proven, so he keeps putting Elodie through one test after another, each one designed to push her a little further. Time after time, she endures it, until their relationship reaches ninety-nine tests in all. But once the ninety-ninth test is over, the balance begins to shift. Elodie stops fighting to win his approval, the bonds around them start to break, and Adrian is forced to face questions about her he never expected to ask.

What If the Woman You Tested 99 Times Was Testing You All Along?

Modern Romance 💖

Modern

Elena keeps being pushed aside by her husband, Adrian, who always chooses Sophie—even when Elena is facing a dangerous pregnancy hemorrhage. When her trust in the marriage finally breaks, she disappears, carrying their unborn son in secret. Four years later, she comes back as a rising aviation designer with Theo by her side. As Adrian uncovers the truth, Sophie’s lies begin to collapse and his empire starts to fall. Now he has to confront the price of every choice he made—and the family he left behind.

Three Minutes Late, He Lost His Wife and Son

Modern

On Christmas Day, Natalie watches her sister-in-law stand over a brand-new luxury car as it goes up in flames, then hear her demand that Natalie be the bigger person. But the ruined car belongs to the woman asking for forgiveness. After being slapped, set up, and shamed in public, Natalie reveals the truth. From that moment on, the people who betrayed her will have to answer for every lie—and kneel before the woman they tried to ruin.

Wrong Car, Sweet Karma

Modern

For three years, Elena played the perfect understanding girlfriend, always giving in to Adrian and even Sophie. She ended up covering the bill for five while only four ate, becoming the butt of every joke. But when her design success was stolen and Adrian left her in the pouring rain, she finally saw the truth. Cutting every tie, she walked away to Boston and began a new life, while the man who wronged her was left with nothing but regret.

Five Seats, One Betrayal

Modern

I spent years loving Ethan, until he told me to tempt Noah, his biggest racing rival, and throw him off his game. I expected the icy champion to keep me at a distance. Instead, he drew me in and made me feel seen. Now Ethan’s confidence is slipping as Noah keeps winning on the track—and keeps getting closer to me. But am I only a pawn in their rivalry, or the one Noah actually wants?

He Sent Me to Seduce His Rival

Modern

Three years after Sera Moretti stepped into Bella’s place and married mafia godfather Salvatore Romano, she still lives as the woman he never truly chose. When Bella comes back and Sera learns she’s pregnant, she’s sure her time is over. Rather than wait to be cast aside, she fakes her death and disappears. But Salvatore won’t accept losing his runaway bride, and what follows is a relentless pursuit for the truth.

After the Substitute Bride Faked Her Death, the Godfather Went Wild

Modern

Cassian Bellandi wants an heir, but the woman he favors, Tessa, turns the pregnancy into leverage for power. Meanwhile, the quiet mistress Fiona begins hearing the unborn baby’s voice—and the child chooses her as his mother. As Fiona becomes pregnant, Tessa’s lies fall apart, the Bellandi family turns on her, and Fiona rises from being ignored to becoming the trusted mother of Cassian’s heir and the new Donna.

The Angel-Baby Chose Me To Bear Him

Modern

At Ridgefield University, Lily the Ice Princess has the Raven hockey team’s three star players wrapped around her finger. Behind her gentle, innocent image, she quietly ruins every relationship they try to build, acting as if the boys belong to her alone. When Sky’s roommate is hurt by their toxic circle, Sky decides to step inside it and strike back. Posing as a sweet, harmless girl, Sky draws close to all three hockey stars and stirs up their rivalry until they turn on each other. As the clique starts to fall apart, Lily’s jealousy and control spin out of control, triggering scheme after scheme and scandal after scandal. In the end, Lily’s fake innocence is revealed. All three players lose both their reputations and their chance to compete, and the four of them vanish from campus. Sky gets her revenge and walks away untouched, never having loved any of them—only playing the victim while controlling everything from the start.

Sweetheart on Ice: I Destroyed Their Clique

Modern

Wren, a billionaire heiress, is constantly overlooked by her boyfriend and three childhood friends, who reserve all their care for the delicate Lila. Again and again, she is the one left behind—soaked at an amusement park, stranded on a mountain, and abandoned alone in a foreign country. Then, on her birthday, a deadly mudslide hits the villa. The others escape with Lila, believing Wren is doomed, and are consumed by guilt. But Wren has already made her move. She disappears without a trace, begins a new life overseas, and leaves the people who hurt her with nothing but regret and a lifetime of chasing what they lost.

Invisible Goodbye

Modern

I used to think Ethan, my controlling stepbrother, had shut me out because he hated me. But the truth was hidden in the small things—his warm milk, the nights he came into my room just to stay beside me while I slept. When I finally understood that his distance was shaped by forbidden feelings he had fought for years, I could no longer deny the crush I had buried too. As his obsession and terror of losing me surface, we’re pushed toward a dangerous truth neither of us can avoid.

My Stepbrother's Secret

Modern

Sienna is finished with Grant’s cheating and the constant interference of his childhood sweetheart. During a road trip, one stolen kiss in the backseat changes everything—and the man beside her is none other than Rhett Calloway, Grant’s untouchable cousin and a celebrated hockey star who has wanted her in secret for years. After Sienna leaves Grant and breaks free from the family that has been controlling her life, Rhett is ready to stand by her openly. But when her ex tries to win her back, he learns too late that Sienna has already moved on.

Kissing Behind His Back

Modern

On the day of her wedding, Ella was abandoned—until Alex stepped in and saved her from the disgrace. Grateful, she married him, only to endure three miscarriages over the next three years. The truth was devastating: Alex had been secretly giving her abortion-inducing medication to preserve Amy’s happiness. Shattered, Ella walked away, rebuilt her life as a screenwriter, and found her freedom. In the end, Alex turned on Amy and was brought to justice, while Ella embraced a new beginning.

The Cruel Cost Of Love

Modern

A nightmare shows Emily a painful future with Luca, and she turns instead to Ethan, the steady MC sergeant who has loved her in silence for years. As jealous exes and family pressure close in, his long-hidden devotion slowly becomes impossible to ignore.

I left them with nothing but regret, because my dad always taught me: if they try to make you kneel, stand even taller.

Blood Family Rejected Me, My Grizzly Dad Made Me King

Modern

Roman Blackwood was once a feared kingpin of the underworld. After his wife died, he left that life behind to give his daughter Evelyn a quiet future, while raising four adopted sons to guard her. But when Evelyn reaches out for help, Roman learns the boys he trusted have chosen to stand with the girl who made her suffer. To them, he’s only an old father. They have no clue who they’ve crossed.

You Made My Daughter Cry. Now Kneel

Modern

Callum, a billionaire, hides who he really is and lives as a homeless man to search for his childhood sweetheart. Even with her family’s harsh humiliation and a corporate executive vying for her hand, Nora still chooses him. An old toy ring links them to a love story that began ten years ago—and to a secret no one expected.

The Billionaire Fiance Begging for a Dollar

Modern

Silas is dismissed as nothing more than a struggling diner owner, and even his fiancée’s children treat him like he’ll never belong. But behind that plain front, he’s a billionaire—and the feared mafia don ruling New York is his long-lost brother. Once the truth is revealed, the people who sneered at him understand they were never rejecting an ordinary future stepfather.

The Wrong Stepfather to Cross

Modern

After Noah is betrayed by his friend Maddox and fiancée Evelyn and left to take the fall for a deadly car crash, he ends up behind bars. There, he earns the protection and inheritance of a mafia godfather, and is released ahead of schedule. When he returns to find his parents hurt and himself mocked at the engagement party, Noah finally shows his true power and strikes back at the traitors.

They Sent Me to Prison, I Came Back Their Boss

Modern

Marco De Luca, the heir to the feared De Luca crime family, arrives in New York for an arranged engagement, only to be ambushed by betrayal. His fiancée Isabella stands by as her toxic childhood friend Nico brutally breaks Marco’s legs and snatches the ring left by his late mother. Marco calls his emergency alert, and his father comes armed and ready. Faced with that force, the Morettis hand over their prized East Coast docks to protect what remains of their family.

She Let Him Break My Legs, I Took Her Empire

Modern

Spurned by his ex-wife and weighing 200 pounds, he braves a stormy night to save the daughter of a powerful woman leader. To ease the little girl’s fear, he enters a fake marriage—but when danger keeps coming, he stands guard with only his body and a frying pan. Slowly, the family’s contempt turns to admiration, and the lonely hearts of mother and daughter begin to soften. What starts as a pretense gradually grows into real love, leading him to the home, dignity, smile, hope, and affection he never expected.

The 200-Pound Man and the Mafia Donna — She Said I Woke Up Her Body and Gave Her a Home

Modern

Cast aside as the Ravello Mafia family’s forgotten fourth son, I was ridiculed as useless while my brothers fought for power and Sabina chose Dario over me. But behind that image, I was a brilliant engineer and a deadly weapons expert. When our estate came under attack, I emerged from the shadows and turned the tide with a single shot. The one they dismissed rose to become the new Don of the Ravello family.

The Garage Don: Tear It All Apart

Modern

My fiancée humiliated me in front of everyone after blowing $100 million of my money on her assistant's birthday gift. She believed I'd keep financing her, keep forgiving her, and keep coming back. But I chose a different path—I called my dad and told him to reinstate the arranged marriage. Now she's parading another man to provoke me. Let her try. At the next family dinner, I'll announce my wedding, and she still won't realize she'll never be the bride.

Same Wedding. Different Bride

Modern

Ethan grows up in rural Montana under the care of a hidden tycoon, only to discover he is the missing heir to a wealthy New York family. Looked down on by his fake family, a scheming adopted brother, and an arrogant fiancée because of his country appearance, he turns the tables with his double Harvard degree and his secret role as Wall Street’s financial legend. Once the swapped baby truth and the villain’s crimes are exposed, Ethan walks away from the luxury fortune and chooses a quiet life in the countryside with his beloved adoptive dad and his restored birth parents.

The Country Boy Is a Billionaire Heir

Modern

Nick Ashcroft walked away from a trillion-dollar empire for Sophia, only to see her choose her rich first love instead. While his ailing grandmother pleaded on Sophia’s behalf, Nick was betrayed and forced to face the cost of his sacrifice. Now he is back on the throne he left behind, and with a powerful new fiancée beside him, Sophia is about to realize exactly who she lost.

My Ex Chose a Billionaire, Not Knowing I’m a Trillionaire

Modern

Arthur thought he was confronting a betrayal. Instead, he wakes drugged on an Arctic research ship, trapped in Eleanor and Julian’s cruel revenge. They dismiss him as nothing more than a worthless trophy husband, never realizing he is Dr. Arthur—the billionaire scientist who secretly financed Eleanor’s entire empire. The moment he cuts off the money, everything she built begins to fall apart. In the end, Arthur leaves with loyal Noah, the one person who has always loved him, while Eleanor is left with nothing.

My Wife Harmed Me For Her Assistant, But I’m Her Secret Investor

Modern

After his wife shames his weight, cheats on him, and reveals the boy he has raised for five years isn't his, Elias is left broke and homeless. Desperate, he takes a live-in nanny job for a feared mafia queen, only to have her quiet son look at him and whisper, "Daddy." When his ex comes back to humiliate him, his new boss shuts her down: "Are you calling my husband a monster?" But that voice stirs a memory from six years ago—a dark hotel room, a mysterious woman, and a gun. Could his new boss be the stranger he spent that night with?

The Fat Manny Is the Mafia Heirs Real Dad

Modern

For seven years, Ryan Morgan hides his wealth and lives under a mask to protect heiress Ashley Prescott. But on their wedding day, Ashley chooses her best friend Liam instead, all for his child. Shattered, Ryan disappears and later marries the formidable mafia queen Valentina. Years pass, and when he returns to New York, Ashley and Liam dismiss him as a nobody at the airport and again at a gala. Soon, the truth comes to light, and Ashley is left broken while Ryan stands beside the family that truly loves him—and the power he never lost.

The Broke Husband You Dumped Is Secretly a Billionaire

Modern

Once a New York mob boss, Marcelo walks out of ten years in prison to a world that has moved on without him—his empire gone, his daughter buried in debt and abuse. The one person willing to stand beside him is Ethan, the beggar boy Marcelo once saved, now an IRS director with the power to strike back. As they uncover the plot behind the collapse of Marcelo’s family, he faces a harsher truth than revenge: to save his daughter, he must destroy the criminal empire he created and face the child who thinks he left her behind.

The Kingpin Is Free: Time to Settle the Score

Tit for Tat

Once a starving street boy, billionaire Dominic owes his life to Don Sal, who gave him a gold watch to help save his dying mother. Years later, Sal is the one who suffers: he covers for Tommy and Frankie, is sent to prison, and after his release is humiliated and stripped of everything by the same two men. Dominic returns with his people to repay the debt, expose the betrayers, rescue Sal’s abused daughter Sofia, and restore every stolen possession to the man who once saved him.

From Beggar to King:The Billionaire's Backing

Tit for Tat

A chance encounter in an auto repair shop turns into a dangerous deal. Eliot, NASA’s lead engineer, is pretending to be Luna’s boyfriend, only to be rudely dismissed as nothing more than help. With family tensions mounting and secrets threatening to spill, can their fake romance last through Thanksgiving night, or will it fall apart before it truly begins?

Limited Time, infinite Pull

Real Life 🏠

Modern

For eight years, Henry Foster kept his gun buried and lived as a gentleman to fulfill his mother’s last wish. But when his fiancée’s spoiled adopted brother humiliates him, takes over his estate, and goes too far, Henry’s patience starts to give way. As betrayal, stolen influence, and a dangerous plot come to light, Sicily is about to face the return of the man once feared as the Reaper.

No More Playing Nice: Sicily's Reaper Is Back

Modern

Elara Quinn learns her five-year marriage to old-money heir Soren Vale was never legally real—because his true wife is Naomi. To her shock, the quadruplets she raised are actually theirs, and Soren had only pretended to be disabled to keep her trapped. Shattered, Elara leaves with her childhood friend Adrian Cross, now a powerful heir. While Soren begs for forgiveness, she refuses to look back. By the end, Elara finds love and happiness with Adrian, and Soren and Naomi must face what they have done.

I Found Someone New—My Quadruplets & Ex Regretted Like Crazy

Modern

Victor Carter was never an ordinary son—he was raised by the most feared mafia family as their treasured heir. But when he steps back into the wealthy Ashford household, he’s met with cold favoritism: their adopted son Leo comes first, and Victor is treated like an outsider. He won’t plead for acceptance. Instead, he buys the house next door, brings the Carter family’s influence into the picture, and forces the Ashfords to confront the meaning of respect and boundaries. A sharp tale of power, payback, and refusing to settle.

They Rejected Me. I'm the Mafia Don's Heir.

Modern

Dario loses everything after a toxic marriage leaves him broke and without a home. Then he takes on an unusual role as stepfather to the young son of New York’s most feared woman. What starts as a marriage of convenience quietly turns into the first true family he has ever had. After once losing himself, Dario must face one question: can love still be freedom?

When Home Stopped Being a Cage

Family

Valerian, the Moretti mafia family’s fourth son, has long been dismissed as a hopeless fool, even by the fiancée who abandons him for his brother. But when a brutal enemy assault threatens the estate, he shocks everyone by revealing deadly talent with guns and machines, saving his family alone. The people who mocked him now beg for mercy, while his resentful ex-fiancée schemes for revenge and stronger enemies move in. No longer the family’s overlooked son, Valerian rises from humiliation to become the underworld’s most feared ruler. His rise has only just begun.

The Mafia Prince They Underestimated

Modern

For years, Liam Parker kept four childhood friends at the center of his life, only to be ignored and left behind when he needed them most. Even his mother always seemed to choose Noah over him. Fed up with being the one everyone relies on but no one truly values, Liam wins admission to a top astronomy university and quietly disappears from their lives. Free from one-sided bonds, he begins again and steps into a future where he is finally respected, appreciated, and never abandoned.

They Could Only See Him, Never Me

Modern

For five years, Nora thought her husband was just a man scraping by with coupons. Then the truth shattered everything: Silas is the Vane family heir—and the secret wealthy husband of her best friend, Sienna. Their marriage certificate was never filed, their savings were gone, and their home had already been sold. Heartbroken, Nora left for Iceland alone. One hundred and fifty days later, Silas showed up begging for another chance. But can forgiveness be found on clearance too?

My Husband Married My Best Friend

Modern

Ethan Mercer is gone—now Ethan Voss, the lost son of a medical empire, he comes back to take down Cole Hayes and claim the South Harbor project. He moves fast, using patents, logistics, and the press as weapons. But Cole is tougher than he looks: with backing from his adoptive father’s northern industrial power, a concealed scientific edge, and Ava Bennett by his side, he keeps turning Ethan’s schemes back on him. As careers collapse and family secrets spill into the open, Cole strips away everything Ethan built. Yet the real fight begins when an even stronger foe appears at his engagement party.

Farm Boy? Billionaire! 2
